title: VS Code user settings and sync state
whyItMatters: The VS Code user folder holds personal settings, recent workspace names and the sign-in state for Settings Sync. Tokens pasted into settings and extension state can be reused by anyone with the disk.
source: VS Code docs, Settings file locations: user settings live in %APPDATA%/Code/User on Windows - https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/configure/settings
notes: settings.json, keybindings.json, snippets and globalStorage/state.vscdb (Settings Sync state and extension storage) live here. Workspace history names recent projects. Contents are not read.

cleanup.exportFirst: Copy settings.json and any snippet files you want to keep to a drive you are taking with you.
cleanup.signOut: Turn off Settings Sync in VS Code with the Settings Sync: Turn Off command, so the account stops trusting this machine.
steps: Open VS Code and turn Settings Sync off from the Accounts menu.
Uninstall Visual Studio Code from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes personal VS Code settings, keybindings, snippets and sign-in state from this PC. Settings already synced stay in the account.
